messages:
sam-sales: Heads-up — Greenline Health is ready to sign the order form but legal flagged redlines in the MSA + DPA. Need help routing the envelope for two-stage signing (contract -> finance) and confirming PO metadata. Link to docs: https://drive.redwood/greenline/orderform-v3.pdf
raj-legal: On it. Quick Q: customer wants to preserve our SLA but add a scheduled-maintenance carveout. What uptime % are they requiring? Also they requested HSM/KMS custody language — we usually handle that via an addendum. cc @emma-ops
emma-ops: We can support HSM for Private installs. For Hosted we offer partner KMS integrations / BYO-key options. Which deployment is Greenline targeting?
sam-sales: Starting Hosted API, plan Dedicated later in Q3. So we need hosted KMS path. They also redlined data residency to eu-west-1 only — feasible?
raj-legal: EU-only residency is doable but requires region-pin addendum. For the SLA carveout, propose a limit (we should agree on max maintenance window). For signatures: they want sequential signing (contract signer then finance). Also they insist PO must be attached to envelope. @nicole-se can you ensure PO field included?
nicole-se: Yes — DocuSign supports custom fields and signing order. I can add a PO number field and enforce sequence. Who are the signer emails? Also note: our e-sign verification policy triggers identity verification for deals >= $100k.
sam-sales: Signers are alice.green@greenline.com (contract) and finance@greenline.com (PO). Deal value ~85k, so below the identity threshold. Finance might still ask for tax docs.
invoice-bot: Attached: PO #GL-2026-045 uploaded to thread (invoice-bot).
emma-ops: For Hosted + BYO KMS, we'll need to enable external-KMS on their tenant — adds ~2-3 business days. SLA carveout ok but we prefer maintenance window <= 4 hours/month (we can't accept very large windows).
raj-legal: I'll counter-propose 4 hours/month. Also I'll inline the KMS addendum language. One more product detail: they asked for automatic fallback to a cheaper model variant if capacity constrained — that's a routing policy item. @nicole-se / engineering to confirm compatibility on the order form.
nicole-se: I'll include two order form variants: (A) Hosted w/ BYO KMS addendum, (B) Dedicated option with reserved capacity pricing. Each will have clear line items and PO field. Creating DocuSign envelope now.
sam-sales: Great — can legal confirm DPA edits + confirm signer sequencing? I want to send to customer today if possible.
raj-legal: I'll finish DPA redline and signoff by EOD. Please share the DocuSign draft with me once created. :thumbsup:
nicole-se: Draft envelope created — DocuSign ID: 0dfc1234. Shared with sam-sales and raj-legal for review. Includes custom field PO=GL-2026-045 and signingOrder=sequential.
sam-sales: Received — thanks. I'll hold until raj gives final approval then send to Greenline. Ping me if anything blocks.
